steps.action: Ensure proper completion of Form I-9
steps.executor_reason: The employer must ensure the individual completes section 1 and signs the attestation.
If the individual is unable to complete the Form I-9, someone may assist them.
The employer must physically examine the documents and ensure they appear genuine and relate to the individual.
The employer must complete section 2 and sign the attestation.
The employer must retain the Form I-9 for three years after the date of hire or one year after the date of termination, whichever is later.
If the individual's employment authorization expires, the employer must reverify on the Form I-9 not later than the date of expiration.
The employer must provide at least three business days notice prior to an inspection of Forms I-9 by authorized agency.
